correctness.rationale: For n=8, exactly C8=1430 noncrossing matchings use the 64 opposite-parity chords. The signed Catalan interval recurrence D(a,b)=sum_{j-a odd} sign(a,j)D(a+1,j)D(j+1,b) equals every Walsh coefficient. Independent inclusion-exclusion W(S)=sum_{A subset S}(-2)^|A| N(A) independently enumerated ALL 1430 matchings and ALL chord supports of weights 1..4, yielding zero counts (0,0,0,544) and four-edge degree shapes exactly 256 stars and 288 brooms. I inspected the second C++17 source: canonicalizes all 32 dihedral images, weights each distinct orbit correctly, and outputs the 17 orbit representatives in ORBIT_CERTIFICATE.txt, each orbit size 32. General even n=2k star construction selects one chord from each mirrored Catalan pair around a vertex; exactly half matchings contain a selected chord, giving 2n 2^k distinct zeros. No false infinite sharpness extrapolated from n=8.
